act: Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989
title: Mischief by fire or explosive substance destroying human dwelling or property (Arson)
description: Commits mischief by fire or any explosive substance intending to cause or knowing that it will cause destruction of any building which is ordinarily used as a place of human dwelling or as a place for custody of property.

act: Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989
title: Offence punishable with imprisonment of 10+ years against person/property (Murder Threat / Grievous Hurt)
description: Commits any offence under the Indian Penal Code punishable with imprisonment for a term of ten years or more against a person or property on the ground that such person is a member of a Scheduled Caste or a Scheduled Tribe.

act: Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989
title: Wrongful Confinement, Obstruction of Passage & Compelling to Leave Residence
punishment: Imprisonment 6 months to 5 years and fine
description: Obstructing or preventing any member of SC/ST from using common passage, road, or public conveyance (Sec 3(1)(za)); or compelling/luring to leave residence, house, or village (Sec 3(1)(n)).

act: Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989
title: Imposing or Threatening Social or Economic Boycott
punishment: Imprisonment 6 months to 5 years and fine
description: Imposes or threatens a social or economic boycott of any person or a family on the ground that such person is a member of a Scheduled Caste or a Scheduled Tribe.

act: Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989
title: Denial of Access to Drinking Water Source or Fouling Public Water
punishment: Imprisonment 6 months to 5 years and fine
description: Obstructing or preventing access to a water source or spring, well, tank, handpump; or corrupting/fouling the water so as to render it less fit for the purpose for which it is ordinarily used.

act: Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989
title: Wrongful Dispossession, Encroachment, or Cultivation of Land
punishment: Imprisonment 6 months to 5 years and fine
description: Wrongfully dispossesses a member of SC/ST from his land or premises or interferes with the enjoyment of his rights over any land, premises or water bodies; or wrongfully occupies/cultivates SC/ST land.

act: Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989
title: Intentional Insult, Intimidation & Abuse by Caste Name in Public View
punishment: Imprisonment 6 months to 5 years and fine
description: Intentionally insults or intimidates with intent to humiliate a member of SC/ST in any place within public view; or abuses any member of SC/ST by caste name in any place within public view.

act: Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989
title: Assault or Force on SC/ST Woman with Intent to Outrage Modesty / Sexual Exploitation
description: Intentionally touches a woman belonging to SC/ST knowing that she belongs to SC/ST, without her consent; or uses words, acts or gestures of a sexual nature; or outrages modesty.

act: Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989
title: Coercion, Threat to Witness/Victim & Protection Rights Violation
punishment: Imprisonment up to 1 year or fine
description: Duty of state to protect victims and witnesses from intimidation, threat, inducement or violence; right to be treated with dignity and protected against coercion to withdraw or compromise.
